name: create-skill-eval
description: Author a frozen, graded eval harness for ONE inner skill and freeze it inside that skill as a conformant eval/ directory (scenarios + deterministic evaluator + rubric + fixtures + HARNESS.md manifest). The eval content is skill-specific; this skill is the reusable methodology that produces it. Its output is consumed read-only by optimize-skill-loop. Use BEFORE optimizing — when a skill needs a graded before/after harness built. Trigger phrases: "build an eval harness for <skill>", "create a skill eval", "instrument <skill> with a frozen grader", "write scenarios and a rubric for <skill>".
